superseded_forks.rationale: Two orchestrator-scope forks of the population module carry verdict 'keep'; only one can be hybrid/population.py. This one is the older: last touched 2026-03-13 against 2026-04-01 for the survivor, and it lacks the FastSpikeDatabase class the survivor defines. The survivor is also the file S0.1 wrote the working-branch bytes to, so demoting this one keeps the working branch canonical. Nothing is deleted and no byte changes.
Documents the superseded population fork and travels with it. Demoted for the same reason, so that the package carries exactly one README per subpackage.

The older parameter fork: last touched 2026-03-22 against 2026-04-01, and it still carries the hardcoded Potjans-Diesmann full_scale_num_neurons and conn_probs arrays with the X = ['TC','L23E',...] naming, where the survivor reads column properties from Connectomics(Calculate=False) and uses the L23_exc / L4_ss vocabulary the rest of the project speaks. Demoting it also removes four duplicate top-level class names (general_params, point_neuron_network_params, multicompartment_params, MorphoPath) from the installed package.
